name: Prepare a small team offsite
why: Checks whether an offsite is worth its cost and builds a decision-first agenda, a natural first step before the event brief and budget.

name: Prepare a community event access plan
why: Writes an arrival-to-exit access plan and the questions to send the venue, the hands-on side of the access checklist.

name: Make a readable event poster
why: Makes a poster whose date, place and price can be read from a distance, checked against the event facts.

name: Plan an event follow up that earns a reply
why: Groups follow-up drafts by what each person asked for and tracks every promise made on the day.

name: Build a clear sponsorship decision brief
why: Compares a sponsorship's cost and audience fit and proposes a capped pilot, matching the sponsorship step of the trade show plan.

name: Trade show experiment planner
why: Plans a small first trade show test with a cost cap and a continue or stop rule, before committing to a full stand.

name: Customer event experiment planner
why: Plans a small customer event as a test, with cost cap, owner and stop rule.

name: Taster event planner
why: Plans a one-day tasting event with costs, a sampling script and a pass rule, useful for food and drink clients.

name: Supplier quote table builder
why: Puts supplier quotes in one table with cash up front and a go or walk call before any deposit is paid.

name: Build a volunteer induction checklist
why: Turns volunteer roles and rules into an induction checklist, useful for community events run with volunteer crews.

name: Monthly budget versus actual keeper
why: Tracks budget against actual spend, the habit behind closing an event's books against its quotes.
